About Our Team – SKYNETICS 🚀

We are SKYNETICS, a passionate and enthusiastic team of six members driven by curiosity, creativity, innovation, and a shared interest in space science and technology.

Our goal is to explore challenging problems, transform creative ideas into practical solutions, and contribute to the future of space exploration. We are particularly interested in astronomy, space technology, scientific research, artificial intelligence, software development, and STEM education.
